name: model-picker
description: Applies Anthropic's 'Which Claude model should you build with?' guidance: injects model/effort rules at session start, checks every Agent, team-member, and Workflow launch for an explicit, task-appropriate model, and can delegate the choice to a decisions API (OpenAI, Google, any LiteLLM gateway, or a custom command) with an optional local-model tier, and keeps a local ledger of decisions, subagent token usage, cost, and estimated savings with a /model-picker:report view. Stamps subagent results with the model that actually ran, and ships an Ollama MCP tool (ask_local) for a $0 local tier.
